scene.title: Three teams need the same Jira and CRM tools, so you build one MCP server they all share
scene.sceneHtml:
TicketFlow: Week 10

Three teams need the same Jira and CRM integrations. Copying custom tool code into each app creates drift and duplicate maintenance. You build an MCP server: Jira/CRM tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol. All teams consume it as a shared service. Write once, reuse everywhere.

takeaways: MCP exposes tools, resources and prompts over JSON-RPC (stdio/http/sse); clients call tools/list to discover and tools/call to execute.
Choose by scope: shared integration across teams/apps → MCP server; app-private logic → custom @tool; dev-workflow instructions → Skill.
MCP tools appear to Claude as mcp__<server>__<tool> (e.g. mcp__jira__create_issue); add them to allowed_tools to pre-approve.
Secure MCP: tokens via env/headers from a secrets manager, per-user OAuth scopes, narrow tools, and treat tool results as untrusted data.
